prototypes.title: pano recycle bin behavior
prototypes.summary: Sample data, not real results. Drag Paño, Phill's cat, onto the desktop Recycle Bin: his eyelids drop, the bin spits him out, he sits down, licks his paw and says "How dare you try to recycle me, human." Works with mouse, touch, or a one-tap "Try to recycle Paño" button.

prototypes.title: Project impact dashboard
prototypes.summary: Sample data, not real results. Dashboard for business analysts showing Phill's methodology for driving measurable impact: the method (business case → metrics, tools & systems, tracking & iteration) and real metrics (42% revenue growth, $8.6M process savings, 3.2x user adoption, 24hrs fulfillment time reduction, 18-month cultural transformation).

prototypes.title: Interactive skills radar chart
prototypes.summary: Sample data, not real results. Radar chart showing Phill's depth across five core dimensions: Business, Process, Systems, Data, and Product. Each shows the specific tools and methods used. Interactive—hover any skill to highlight it.
